The '''Alsaka sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] as well as the [[Opatajji system/Legends|Opatajji system]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the sector was defended by a [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
